mock.title: Heading of the Profile page's only card on a development server, where people sign in by picking a test user (no real accounts).
mock.signedIn: {{name}} is the signed-in person's name, {{role}} their workspace role (Admin, Member…). "Sign-in picker" is the development sign-in that lists test users; "the account menu" is the menu under the person's avatar. The _nobody form is shown when no one is signed in.
name.title: Heading of the card where the person changes the name others see on conversations, issues and comments.
name.label: Accessible name of the text field with the person's name, in the Name card of their Profile page.
name.save: Button in the Name card: saves the person's new name.
name.saved: Toast after the new name saved.
passkeys.title: A passkey is a sign-in credential stored on a device (fingerprint, face or PIN) that replaces a password. Use your platform's usual term for passkeys.
passkeys.list: Accessible name of the list of the person's passkeys (read by screen readers).
passkeys.unnamed: Shown for a passkey saved without a name, and the name a new passkey gets when the field is left empty.
passkeys.created: The date a passkey was added, in the reader's locale (only the date).
passkeys.remove: Button on one of the person's passkeys: deletes that passkey.
passkeys.empty: Shown in the Passkeys card when the person has no passkeys.
passkeys.nameLabel: Accessible name of the text field for a new passkey's name.
passkeys.namePlaceholder: Placeholder in the new passkey's name field; "Laptop" is an example device name.
passkeys.add: Button in the Passkeys card: starts adding a new passkey on this device.
passkeys.added: Toast after a new passkey was added.
password.title: Heading of the card on the person's Profile page where they change their password.
password.current: Label and placeholder of the field for the person's current password.
password.new: Label of the field for the new password.
password.newPlaceholder: Placeholder of the new password field: "(10+)" means at least 10 characters.
password.changed: Toast after the password changed: every other session (on other devices) was signed out.
sessions.title: Heading of the card with the button that signs the account out on every device.
sessions.signOutEverywhere: Button in the Sessions card: signs this account out on every device, this one included.
leave.title: Heading of the card where the person ends their own membership in the workspace (team).
leave.button: Destructive button that opens the confirmation to leave the workspace.
leave.confirmTitle: Title of the confirmation dialog before leaving the workspace.
leave.confirmBody: The phone app is the Socio mobile app; it deletes its local copy of the workspace when signed out.
leave.left: Toast after the person left the workspace; they are signed out next.
social.title: Heading of the card where a person links Google or Apple accounts to sign in with. Google and Apple are brand names.
social.list: Accessible name of the list of Google and Apple accounts linked for sign-in, on the person's Profile page in Settings.
social.linked: One linked account. {{name}} is Google or Apple; {{at}} is when it was linked; {{email}} is that account's address.
social.unlink: Button beside one linked Google or Apple account on the Profile page: removes the link, so it can't be used to sign in any more.
social.result.canceled: Shown on the Profile page after the person came back from Google's or Apple's page without finishing the link.
social.result.nonce-invalid: After coming back from Google's or Apple's page when the attempt can't be used.
